# Generated by tools/gen_font.py; git-ignored for font-licensing reasons
# (see NOTICE). Without it the CJK UI would render boxes, so fail loudly.
if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/rw1_font.c")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "device/main/rw1_font.c missing - generate the CJK font subset first:\n"
        "    python ../tools/gen_font.py")
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "main.c"
        "accel_input.c"
        "wifi_link.c"
        "net_config.c"
        "prov_form.c"
        "provisioning.c"
        "sd_card.c"
        "sd_log.c"
        "transport.c"
        "led_feedback.c"
        "ui.c"
        "rw1_font.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES
        esp_wifi
        esp_netif
        esp_event
        nvs_flash
        lwip
        esp_timer
        esp_http_client
        esp_http_server
        json
        led_indicator
)
